verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents the separate pieces this story needs. It covers issuing equity to employees with ESOP management, vesting schedules and built-in e-signing (eqvista-docs-8, -7, -10, -11), and it offers board resolutions and voting (eqvista-docs-24, -25). It also performs in-house 409A valuations (eqvista-docs-4, -28, eqvista-probe-1). Nothing in the evidence shows these linked into one workflow: no documentation shows a grant routed through board approval or a strike price set automatically from the 409A. missing for 10: evidence of an integrated grant→board-approval→409A-strike flow, option-specific grant documentation (vs. share issuance), independent or hands-on corroboration.
